name_zh: 允许不匹配质量的部分运输
formal_object: Nonnegative plan Pi and unmatched masses s,t with Pi1+s=a, Pi^T1+t=b; costs c, unmatched cost gamma>0.

operations.input: Forced full correspondence despite incompatible surfaces
operations.condition: The two generated surfaces need not match everywhere
operations.output: Allow unexplained mass without inventing a target

operations.input: Partial transport with explicit rejection cost
operations.condition: Nonnegative slack and preserved output denominator

derivation_steps.statement: Minimize <c,Pi>+gamma(1^T s+1^T t)+epsilon sum Pi(log Pi-1).
derivation_steps.justification: The slack formulation permits infeasible full matches to remain unmatched.

derivation_steps.statement: At epsilon=0, adding a small transport mass removes the same mass from each slack, changing cost by (c_ij-2gamma) times mass.
derivation_steps.justification: Differentiate the linear local tradeoff on available slack.

derivation_steps.statement: Every unmatched source vertex still receives the frozen native decoder prediction.
derivation_steps.justification: Rejection changes the construction, never the benchmark denominator.

assumptions: Finite cost model and rejection threshold are fixed on development data.
The sharp 2gamma threshold describes the unregularized limit; entropy smooths it.
Rejection is for unsupported surface matching, not a new occlusion benchmark or supplied failure label.
A fallback is required for every source vertex and frame.
method_expression: Solve partial transport; lift matched corrections and retain native decoder motion for unmatched mass. Evaluate all original vertices/times.
distinguishing_prediction: Compared with C06, rejection should help under source/target mismatch but has no reason to help when full matching is correct.
falsifier: Reject if gains arise only by dropping scoring points or if a confidence-threshold native fallback with the same budget performs equally well.
closest_alternative: Classical partial/unbalanced transport and threshold-and-fallback matching.
decisive_comparison: Full versus partial assignment versus confidence-threshold fallback, identical outputs and official scoring denominator; retain rejected mass.
operational_delta: Adds a no-match decision and native fallback, rather than imposing another marginal or lowering confidence temperature.
feasibility_and_cost: Partial convex solve and common lift; target support and threshold calibration are unresolved.
algebra_review_basis: Marginal/slack accounting and the 2gamma limiting tradeoff checked. No entropy-case hard cutoff or reduced-denominator claim.
empirical_status: Not implemented in this round; no native method comparison or outcome.
originality_status: Unadjudicated. Classical tools and historical related code are explicitly attributed.
